speedrunnermod.first_time_playing.welcom:
Welcome to the §bSpeedrunner Mod!§f
Before you begin playing, lets explore what this mod is and it's main features.

Use arrow keys < > to navigate pages.
speedrunnermod.key_points:
§e§lKey Features:
§f● Structures generate more commonly.
● New biome, called the §bSpeedrunner's Wasteland,§f which contains great resources for speedrunning.
● §aLoot tables§f are buffed!
● Various new items to help with §aevery aspect§f of §bspeedrunning.
speedrunnermod.mode_option:
There are §a§lthree§r§f §adifferent modes§f in this mod, §b§lEasy,§r§f §e§lBalanced,§r§f and §c§lDoom.
§b§lEasy§r§b mode§f enables all features, making the game beatable in just a couple of minutes.
§e§lBalanced§r§e mode§f limits some features, making the game a little more balanced but still easier to speedrun.
§c§lDoom§r§c mode§r, well, I'll leave that for you to figure out.

§a§lWhich mode do you want to play on?
speedrunnermod.mode.easy.tooltip: Enables all features, results in the quickest speedrunning times.
speedrunnermod.mode.balanced.tooltip: Limits some features, making the game more balanced, resulting in quick speedrunning times.
speedrunnermod.mode.doom.tooltip: Flips the mod's description upside-down, and makes the game extremely difficult in various different ways, resulting in 30-40 minute runs. It's a good challenge, but only if you're up for it!
speedrunnermod.ready_to_play: Alright! Now that you have selected the mode that you want to play on, you are ready to play!
speedrunnermod.enter_feature_screens.too:
When finished, load into the §a§lfeature screens,§r§f where you can learn more about each feature in this mod!

If you don't want to view them now, you can always view them via the §b§oSpeedrunner Mod options menu.
speedrunnermod.restart_required: To fully apply the mode, you will need to restart your game. Then, you will be booted into the title screen, where you can create a new world. You will see some §blight-blue boots,§f press that to §aautomatically create a new world.
